# r/timberwolves (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Minnesota Timberwolves stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Minnesota Timberwolves in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #11 LaMelo Ball 66.8
- #22 Anthony Edwards 63.1
- #71 Rudy Gobert 54.9
- #95 Ayo Dosunmu 52.7
- #136 Donte DiVincenzo 48.1
- #150 Jaden McDaniels 47.4
- #220 Bones Hyland 42.6
- #254 Jonathan Kuminga 41.1

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
